sub_sector.value: HSA custodian; consumer-directed benefits administration (FSA, HRA, COBRA)

financial_business_type.detail: HSA custodian and benefits administrator for HSAs, FSAs, HRAs, COBRA and commuter benefits.

revenue_driver.detail: Account service fees from employers and health plans, custodial interest on HSA cash, and interchange.

customer_type.detail: Employers, health plans and advisors as clients; individual account members; public employers such as state governments.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Custodian and administrator; earns fees and custodial yield without underwriting or lending risk.

notes: Revenue mix (service fees, custodial interest, interchange) comes from background knowledge; the evidence does not detail revenue.
